newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish public debt up to PLN 197.8 bln in Jan-May.
newsitem.headline: Polish public debt up to PLN 197.8 bln in Jan-May.

text.p: Poland's public debt increased by 6.7 percent in nominal terms to 197.8 billion zlotys in the January-May period, the finance ministry said on Wedensday.
At the end of May foreign debt amounted to 54.8 percent of Poland's debt, down from 57.2 percent at the end of 1996.

"The structure of our debt has changed...because of our operation of buying back our Brady bonds and issuing bonds for the central bank to finance the move," Piotr Dziewulski, head of the ministry's public debt department, told a news briefing.
Last month, the ministry bought back $1.69 billion of its Brady bonds, reducing the outstanding amount of the papers, maturing up to October 27, 2024, to $6.05 billion.
